description: Jurisdiction groupings used by Business Mode to decide whether a hop is inside, adequate to, or outside a policy boundary. Country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and match Natural Earth ISO_A2 (fall back to ISO_A2_EH / ADM0_A3 where ISO_A2 is -99, e.g. France, Norway, Kosovo).

EEA.label: European Economic Area (GDPR incorporated via EEA Agreement)

GDPR_ADEQUATE.label: Countries with an EU Commission adequacy decision (transfers allowed without extra safeguards)

conditions.CA: Only organisations subject to PIPEDA (commercial activities).
conditions.US: Only organisations self-certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (check https://www.dataprivacyframework.gov/list). General Court upheld the DPF in Sept 2025 (Latombe, T-553/23); appeal and a July 2026 EDPB letter keep it under review.
conditions.GB: Renewed Dec 2025 under GDPR and LED; runs to 27 Dec 2031.
conditions.BR: Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/179 of 26 Jan 2026; reciprocal ANPD Resolution CD/ANPD 32/2026. Excludes public security/defence/criminal processing.
conditions.JP: Covers private sector under APPI; extended to academia/public sector in 2023.

UK_ADEQUATE.label: Countries covered by UK adequacy regulations ('data bridges')

conditions.US: Only via the UK Extension to the EU-US DPF.

US_DOJ_COUNTRIES_OF_CONCERN.label: Countries of concern under the US DOJ Bulk Sensitive Data Rule (28 CFR Part 202, effective 8 Apr 2025)

STRICT_LOCALIZATION.label: Jurisdictions with broad (non-sector) personal-data localization or mandatory local copy
STRICT_LOCALIZATION.notes: Strength varies a lot. See jurisdictions.json localization.level and notes for each; ID, NG and SA are 'conditional' (public-sector / specific data classes), RU/CN/VN/KZ/BY are 'strict'.

policy_templates.label: EU personal data – stay in EEA
policy_templates.notes: Pure transit of encrypted packets is generally not treated as a 'transfer' under GDPR (EDPB Guidelines 05/2021 focus on making data available to a recipient). The app flags transit as RISK (warning) and storage/termination outside the zone as VIOLATION.

policy_templates.label: EU personal data – EEA + adequate countries
US bulk sensitive data – avoid countries of concern
policy_templates.notes: Conservative: flags any hop geolocated in a country of concern.

policy_templates.label: India payment system data – store only in India
policy_templates.notes: RBI 2018 circular allows foreign processing if data is deleted abroad and returned to India within one business day / 24h.

policy_templates.label: Russian citizens' personal data – primary database in Russia
China important data / CIIO personal data – stay in mainland China
policy_templates.notes: HK and MO are separate jurisdictions for PIPL cross-border purposes.
